name: opcua-mcp-server
description: Read industrial sensors and control equipment on any OPC UA server.
long_description:
Connects Claude to any OPC UA server — a PLC, a SCADA gateway, a historian or a simulator — and exposes it as MCP tools.

Set the endpoint below to your OPC UA server's URL. The default **observe** profile can read, browse and monitor but cannot write, call methods or acknowledge alarms. Use **operator** with explicit target allowlists for production control; **full** is intended for a tightly scoped OPC UA account.

**Security:** the connection defaults to unencrypted and anonymous for local simulation. Control tools remain blocked on an insecure channel unless the lab-only override is enabled. Against real equipment, set Basic256Sha256, a client certificate and key, and credentials scoped to exactly the nodes and methods required.

opcua_server_url.title: OPC UA endpoint
opcua_server_url.description: URL of the OPC UA server to connect to, e.g. opc.tcp://192.168.0.10:4840

opcua_security_policy.title: Security policy
opcua_security_policy.description: Encryption suite to negotiate: None, Basic128Rsa15, Basic256, Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep or Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss. Leave blank for an unencrypted connection. Anything other than None needs the certificate and key below.

opcua_security_mode.title: Security mode
opcua_security_mode.description: Sign or SignAndEncrypt. Leave blank to let the policy choose, which means SignAndEncrypt.

opcua_client_cert.title: Client certificate
opcua_client_cert.description: PEM or DER certificate this client presents. Required by any policy other than None.

opcua_client_key.title: Client private key
opcua_client_key.description: Private key matching the certificate above.

opcua_password.title: Password
opcua_password.description: Required if a username is set. Sent in clear text unless a security policy is configured.

opcua_profile.title: Tool profile
opcua_profile.description: observe (read/monitor only), operator (explicit target allowlists), or full. Restart the connector after changing it.

opcua_policy_file.title: Policy file
opcua_policy_file.description: Optional version-1 JSON policy. Form fields below override values from this file.

opcua_allowed_tools.title: Allowed tools
opcua_allowed_tools.description: Optional comma-separated tool allowlist. It can only narrow the selected profile.

opcua_allowed_write_nodes.title: Writable node IDs
opcua_allowed_write_nodes.description: Comma-separated exact node IDs writable in operator mode.

opcua_allowed_methods.title: Callable methods
opcua_allowed_methods.description: Comma-separated object_node_id|method_node_id pairs callable in operator mode.

opcua_allow_insecure_control.title: Allow insecure control (lab only)
opcua_allow_insecure_control.description: Permit control tools without OPC UA channel security. Never enable against production equipment.
